Commentary.Commentary: Right then, England pride themselves on being the best chasing team.  Now they have their task cut out to chase down this big total. It's time to prove that tag. They possess an in-form batting line-up and we can expect a riveting chase. Don't go too far away as England's reply will get underway shortly.

Ramiz Raja is down with Mohammad Hafeez for a quick chat. 'Professor' says that self-belief was the key as they know they can handle any situation. Tells that the previous game was an off day for them. Reckons the pitch is holding a bit and there is a little turn on offer too. Feels that there is something for the seamers as well and the total they have got is a very good one. Ends by saying he wanted to play according to the situation and it worked well for him as he kept going after the bowlers and it came off.

England's bowling wasn't up to the mark. There wasn't much support from the surface but they were also not consistent with their lines and lengths. Moeen Ali was the standout performer after claiming the top three wickets while Chris Woakes bowled well at the death to take his tally to three wickets as well. Not to forget his four extraordinary catches in the field. Apart from that, the hosts were below par with their ground fielding and leaked plenty of runs. Having said all that, they snapped 4 wickets in the last five overs and that would have given them some momentum heading into the break.

Put to bat, everyone expected the likes of Jofra Archer and Mark Wood to bounce out the Pakistan batsmen. But that didn't happen. Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq were not only watchful but they scored runs at a good rate as well. Every batsman came to the party and Mohammad Hafeez was the one who impressed the most after getting a life on 14. Babar Azam and Sarfaraz Ahmed also were brilliant and Pakistan always looked on track for a total around 350.

This is Pakistan for you - Unpredictable. They got bundled out for 100 odd in their first match and today they have posted their second-best total in a World Cup match. A target of 349 will test England's mighty batting line-up and if they manage to overhaul it, it will be the highest run chase in the mega event.

FOUR! Excellent way to finish the innings. It is on a good length area on middle, Shadab whacks it wide of long on. Morgan there dives to his left but cannot stop it. PAKISTAN FINISH WITH 348/8 OFF THEIR 50 OVERS.
Fuller on off, Khan taps it back to the bowler.

Poor from England in the field once again. Fuller ball on middle and off, Khan hits it towards long on and takes one. The fielder there throws it at the bowler's end. Woakes does not gather it allowing them to take the second.
FOUR! Off the edge but Pakistan won't mind how they come. Back of a length ball on off, Shadab looks to pull but gets a top edge which flies past the keeper and to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Ouch! Bouncer on middle and leg, Ali looks to pull but gets an edge which then hits him on his helmet. The ball goes down towards the third man region for a single.
Shadab Khan walks out to the middle.

OUT! Woakes gets his third of the game and he is having a good day where other pacers have had a rough outing. Good length ball on off, Shoaib looks to hit it over mid off but gets a top edge which goes up in the air towards cover. Eoin Morgan there runs to it and he has one of the safest hands in the world. He won't drop those and he does not.

SIX! That has been thumped! Once again the last ball spoils the over. Another slower one and on off, Hasan clears his front leg, waits for it and then tonks it into the long off stand. End of Archer for today and it is not a day for him to remember. He has gone for 79 in his 10 and not even taken a wicket. 13 needed from the last over to get to 350.
Swing and a miss! Another dot! Short and outside off, Ali looks to drag his pull but misses. This is a top over so far. Needs to end it well.
Another slower one and it is outside off, Malik guides it past point. There is a man in the deep so just a single.
Good slower ball and outside off, Malik looks to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce. Dot, gold dust at this stage.
A yorker and on middle, Hasan cleverly jams it out to mid off for one.
Hasan dives to get in! Good running. This is pushed towards mid on with soft hands. Malik rushes back for the second and Hasan has to go for it. The throw is to the keeper but Hasan is in.
Jofra Archer is back!
On the pads, Malik flicks it down the leg side and gets a couple. Two wickets and 10 runs from the over, an eventful one!
Hasan Ali walks out to bat!

OUT! Second wicket for Woakes in the over. Good length ball around off, Riaz throws the kitchen sink at it but ends up hitting it off the upper half of his bat. The ball lobs up towards point. Joe Root there takes an easy catch.
FOUR! On the pads, Riaz just glances it down the leg side and the ball races away fine down the fine leg region for a boundary.
On middle and leg, Malik flicks it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
WIDE! Misses his line and bowls it down the leg side. Malik looks to flick but misses.
Wahab Riaz is the new man in!

OUT! Slower ball does the trick here. It is on a back of a length, Sarfaraz looks to hit it but then tries to pull out from the shot. He is too late in doing so and ends up lobbing it up to the side of the pitch. Woakes does not want to take any risk and runs after it towards point to take it by himself. He gets there and takes a good catch. Fourth catch for him in this game and his first wicket. End of a very good knock from the skipper, he though will be disappointed to not see through the innings and with the two new batsmen at the crease, 350 looks farfetched.
Brilliant running this. Woakes bowls it full on off, Sarfaraz hits it towards long on. Malik runs the first one hard and calls for the second. He is quick and fit, so he gets it easily.
Chris Woakes is back for another burst.
On the pads, Malik flicks it wide of deep square leg and gets a couple. Excellent over at this stage from Wood. Just 6 runs and a wicket off this one. Wood finishes with figures of 10-0-53-2!
Fuller on middle and leg, Sarfaraz lofts it over mid on towards long on for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Malik runs it down to third man for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Sarfaraz taps it down to backward point and gets a run.
Malik is off the mark. It is full on the pads, Malik turns it down to fine leg and gets a single.

OUT! Asif Ali holes out. Good length ball outside off, Ali throws his bat at it. He connects but it is too close to the fielder at sweeper cover. Jonny Bairstow stationed there moves to his left and takes a very well judged catch over his head. He looks at the crowd and does the fist pump. Asif Ali walks back disappointed. Shoaib Malik replaces him out in the middle.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! Just needless, absolutely needless from England. The pressure is telling on them. Sarfaraz first makes room and cuts it hard to point. He wants a run but Asif is not interested. Ahmed is halfway down the wicket. Root picks the ball up and goes for a shy at the batter's end despite no one backing up. He misses and it goes to the mid-wicket fence. Archer is not happy at all. Sums up England's day in the field today. Sarfaraz gets to a half ton. A captain's knock to be honest. He was under pressure and has delivered brilliantly. He needs to end the innings well though.
FOUR! What a shot! Full on off, Sarfaraz clears his front leg and whacks it over mid on for a boundary.
Safe again. One again Jofra hits the deck hard on a length, Sarfaraz pulls it but gets no timing on it. The ball lands safely again and they tale two once more.

In the air...but safe. Short ball on the body, Sarfaraz pulls it but gets no timing on it. He is lucky that it falls in  no man's land. The fielder from the deep comes running in and they get two. 300 comes up for Pakistan with it.
A very full ball on middle. Almost a yorker, Ali flicks it away to the on side and gets a single.
Good length ball on the body, Sarfaraz makes room and hits it towards long on for one.
Good length ball on the fifth stump line, Sarfaraz moves away from it and then leaves it alone. Not wided by the umpire though.
Good effort from Stokes in the deep. Short ball on off, Ali pulls it wide of deep square leg. Stokes makes the ground and saves it from going to the fence with a dive. He saves two runs for his side.
Play and a miss. Good length ball outside off, Ali looks to hit it but misses.
Another misfield. England have been poor in the field. Good length ball on off, Ali lofts it over mid off. Woakes comes running in from long off but he misfields it allowing them to take one.
Slower ball outside off, Asif throws his bat at it but misses.

In the air...but just short. Back of a length ball outside off, Sarfaraz makes room and looks to hit it over mid off. It hits the upper half of his bat. Woakes at mid off dives in front but even he cannot get there.
A dot to end but a good over for Pakistan! Short and this one is quick. Asif evades it. 13 runs conceded by Archer in this over.
SIX! Asif means business here! What an outrageous shot that is! Shows the power this guy has! Short and it is the slower one. Asif adjusts and slaps it over the cover fence. It goes all the way.
Well bowled! A yorker on the leg pole. Not a lot you can do with that. Sarfaraz hits it towards mid off for one.
Nicely played! Stays leg side of the delivery and guides it wide of third man for a couple.
Slower one and it is outside off, Ali throws the kitchen sink at it but only manages an outside edge down to third man for one.
WIDE! Goes short does Archer but it is too short. Wided.

Direct hit and Sarfaraz was a goner! Ali works it through mid-wicket and they take one. They go for the second which was not on. Bairstow picks the ball up and fires it to the bowler's end. Archer thinks it's going onto the stumps and hence leaves. But it misses the sticks by a whisker.
Play and a miss! Short and outside off, Sarfaraz looks to upper cut it but misses. So, a wonderful comeback by Wood after going for a biggie on the first ball. 8 runs and an important wicket from it.

A huge shout but not given! England have no reviews but would not have mattered as I feel there was bat involved. Full and down the leg side. Sarfaraz looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
The new man in is Asif Ali.

OUT! Woakes takes another excellent catch! A hat-trick of catches for the pacer. Hafeez misses out on a ton by 16 runs. Wood gets a vital breakthrough for England. It is full and on off, Hafeez nonchalantly lofts it wide of long off. Woakes runs to his left and takes it with a dive. End of a brilliant knock by Hafeez. He has set the platform for the big hitters coming in. A crucial part of the game though coming ahead. Will Pakistan capitalize or will England fight back into the game?
Slower one and on off, Sarfaraz guides it towards point and takes one.
Full and outside off, Hafeez lofts it over covers It goes on the bounce to the fielder in the deep. A single.

SIX! On the shorter side and it goes all the way! Poor delivery to begin with and a brilliant start to the 43rd over for Pakistan. On the pads, easy pickings for Hafeez. He flicks it and it clears the fence with ease.
Mark Wood is back into the attack!
Back of a length ball on the body, Hafeez pulls it to deep square leg and gets one. Good over from Jofra. Just 6 off it.
Short again, this time outside off. Hafeez looks to hit it over point but misses.
Bouncer from Jofra. It is a typical fast bowler's response. Hafeez ducks under it.
FOUR! Effortless! Slower ball on off, Hafeez just lofts it over covers and gets a boundary. Moves to 76 with that.
Another low full toss, difficult to hit that, Ahmed strokes it down to long on for one.
Good start by Archer. A yorker and Sarfaraz jams it out to the bowler.
Jofra Archer is back!
Two to finish the over. It is full on off, Hafeez drives it towards cover and gets a couple. 13 off this over.
On the pads, Hafeez flicks it towards square leg and gets a brace.
FOUR! Another bad ball from Stokes. It is on a back of a length, Hafeez pulls it hard over square leg for a boundary.
Better this. Gets it in the blockhole, Sarfaraz gets his bat down in time and gets a run by jamming it out to the off side.
FOUR! Slower one gone wrong. It is full on off, in Sarfaraz' zone and he smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
Full on off, Sarfaraz plays it to the man at mid on.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Yorker outside off, Sarfaraz plays it towards cover and keeps the strike with one.
FOUR! Short ball on middle and leg, Sarfaraz backs away and pulls it over wide mid on and gets a boundary. That also brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
Back of a length ball on off, Hafeez taps it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Once again Sarfaraz makes room and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower ball on off, Hafeez defends it with soft hands and gets one.
Good length ball on leg, Sarfaraz was moving away and he manages to hit it towards mid on and take a run. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good length ball on off, Sarfaraz pulls it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike as he gets a run.
Slower ball yorker. It is a perfect yorker on middle and off, Sarfaraz does well to get his bat down in time to keep it out.
Full on middle and off, Sarfaraz on drives it to the man at mid on.
On the pads, Hafeez flicks it to square leg for a single.
This time Hafeez drives it wide of deep cover and gets a couple.
FOUR! Not the start to the new spell Stokes would have wanted. Slower ball full on off, Hafeez drives it past diving Moeen at cover and the ball hurries away to the boundary.
Ben Stokes is back!
Good fielding again, this time by Bairstow. Sarfaraz hits it nicely towards mid-wicket. Jonny makes good ground to his left, dives and pushes the ball back in. Saves two for his side.
Wide! Too short and Sarfaraz looks to pull but the bails out. Wided.
Nicely played but not fine enough to fetch a boundary. Paddles it but since it is a slower one, there is not a lot of power in the shot. It goes down fine leg for one.
Well-fielded by Roy this time! Short and outside off, Hafeez guides it towards point where Roy saves a run by diving to his left.
Walks across and works this down to fine leg for one.
'AHHHH' shouts Sarfaraz in disgust. Short and outside off, he looks to guide it down to third man but misses.

FOUR! That should get Sarfaraz going! Picks his spot well there but a hit-me ball first up by Woakes. It is short and on middle, Sarfaraz goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket. Ideal way to start the over.
Chris Woakes comes back on, replacing Mark Wood.

Confusion again between the two! This time Hafeez is not looking at his partner. He goes for the sweep to this ball outside off. Misses, it hits his pads and rolls towards the off side. SA wants a run but then seeing Hafeez not interested, the skipper turns back. A good over to end Moeen's spell. His figures 10-0-50-3. Good day for him with the ball.
Just a single now as Ahmed pulls this one to deep mid-wicket.
Another dot! Shortish and outside off, Sarfaraz guides it to short third man.
Flighted ball and outside off, Sarfaraz looks to play inside the line but gets beaten.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Dances down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He works it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep misfields but the other fielder is backing up and hence, only a run.
Good length ball on off, Sarfaraz defends it with soft hands towards cover and takes one to keep the strike.
WIDE! Misses his line here, does Wood. He bowls it down the leg side, SA looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.

Oh dear! England have not been up to the scratch here on the field. Sarfaraz does try to break the shackles but he does not time his pull well. The ball goes towards deep square leg where James Vince comes running to stop the ball. He, though, misfields there which allows the batsmen to come back for the second. We don't usually see this from the English side.
Length ball outside off, Sarfaraz looks to cut but misses. Three dots in a row now for Sarfaraz, will he look to break the shackles here?
Good length ball on off, Sarfaraz defends it off the front foot.
Full around off, Sarfaraz hits it to the man at mid on.
Slower ball outside off, Hafeez runs it down to third man and gets a run.

FOUR! Spoils the over somewhat! Sarfaraz plays the sweep shot but not where he intended to. It goes off the top edge and over short fine leg. Trickles to the fence. Pakistan continue to score at a good rate.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Worked to mid-wicket. A dot.
This is worked through mid-wicket for one.

Big, big mix-up and an easy chance of a run out goes abegging! Roy is the culprit again, not a good day in the field for him. We don't see that quite often. But what is Ahmed doing there? This is pushed with soft hands towards mid on. Hafeez is sprinting towards the other end but Sarfaraz is ball-watching and standing in his crease. Roy runs to his left and looks to pick the ball up but fumbles as he takes his eyes off it. Had he done so, Hafeez was a goner as he was at the point of no return. In the end, no damage done and a single is taken as the ball travels to long on. Hafeez is living a charmed life here.
Sarfaraz comes down the track and whips it through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Fifty for Hafeez. He was dropped by Roy earlier and has made most of it. Fuller on off, Hafeez drives it powerfully straight down the ground and the ball races away to the fence to bring up his 38th ODI fifty.
Good length ball on off, Sarfaraz taps it towards backward point and gets off the mark straightaway.

Direct hit but safe. Good length ball on off, Hafeez strokes it towards extra cover and takes a quick single. Jofra gets to the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Hafeez was in.

FOUR! Pulled and pulled hard! It is short on the body, Hafeez pulls it with power towards backward square leg. Bairstow from deep square leg runs to his right and puts in a dive to stop the ball but fails.
Excellent ball this. Hits the deck hard outside off, Hafeez looks to poke it on the off side but gets beaten.
Bouncer outside off, Hafeez sways away from it. One for the over signalled by the umpire.
Hafeez ends the over with a single as he works this through square leg. End of a successful over for the hosts.
Pakistan skipper, Sarfaraz Ahmed walks out at number 5.

OUT! In the air... taken! Moeen Ali does the trick once again. His third in the game. Azam dances down the track and looks to hit it over long on. He miscues it towards the fielder there and Woakes makes no mistake. Another good catch by him by going down low, simpler than the last one though. Azam fails to convert and England have an opening here. They need to keep chipping away at the wickets if they are to stem the flow of runs.
This is hit wide of short third man for one.

A direct hit and the appeal has been taken upstairs. Hafeez looks calm though. NOT OUT! Hafeez is well in. He guides it down to short third man. He wants a run but is sent back in time. The fielder there hits the stumps at the keeper's end and an appeal follows. Replays show that the batsman is fine.
Turn there for Ali. This is flatter and on off, it comes back in. Azam looks to work it on the leg side but it goes off the pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Plays the sweep straightaway but it goes off the inner half towards deep square leg for.
Moeen Ali is back!

Drinks Break! Pakistan are going strength to strength here. Hafeez and Babar Azam are looking very good out in the middle. The two have added 85 runs off just 71 balls. Pakistan will be hoping that these two continue the good work for as long as possible. England need to not just put the brakes on the run flow, they also need a wicket or two desperately.
A single to end the over as Hafeez guides it down to third man.

The batsman has to hurry but no direct hit makes his life a little easy! On the pads, Azam looks to work but misses to get hit on the pads. A desperate appeal by England as the ball rolls towards mid-wicket. The umpire shakes his head. The batsmen go for a single. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Leg bye signalled. Also, that was always going down leg.
Very straight and this is clipped nicely to deep square leg for one.
Azam lets the ball come to him and then plays it down to third man for one.
In the air but just wide! On the pads, Hafeez looks to flick but is a touch early into the shot. It goes uppishly but wide of mid-wicket for a run.

Bowls it slower and fuller in length. Hafeez strokes it through covers, he takes one and then goes for the second. Makes it in with a dive. The veteran was struggling there. His age was showing on the way he was running.
Mark Wood is back!
Single to end the over. Floated on middle and off, Hafeez sweeps it away to square leg and keeps the strike. 13 from the over!
Slider outside off, Hafeez looks to cut but misses.

FOUR! Hafeez has decided to go after Rashid. Adil over-corrects his length and ends up serving it short. Hafeez gets on his back foot and pulls it away over mid-wicket. There is no one in the deep, so zero risk and he gets a boundary.
SIX! Hafeez is making full use of the life he got. Jason Roy must be kicking himself for dropping him earlier. It is tossed up on off, Hafeez smokes it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Tossed up on off, Azam milks it to long on and gets a single.
Premeditated sweep there. Tossed up on off, Hafeez sweeps it towards fine leg and gets one.
On middle and leg, Hafeez flicks it to the on side and keeps the strike.

NOT OUT! Safely in. Good length ball on the pads, Azam flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes off for a quick run. The fielder there gets to it quickly and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The umpire goes upstairs and the replays show Azam was in without any fuss.
A direct hit at the non-striker's end. Is Azam short? Direct hits are always close. Big moment in the game!
Back of a length ball on off, Azam punches it over point and gets a couple.
Now a quick, sharp bouncer. It is around off, Babar looks to pull it but it comes very quickly onto him and he decides to leave it alone.
Slower ball on a length, Babar pulls it away wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
The ball slips out of Archer's hand as he was running in to bowl. He has to reload again.
Nice ball. Good length ball outside off, it zips off the surface. Babar looks to play it on the off side but misses.
Another single as this is eased through covers for one.
The googly on off, Azam looks to hit it through the off side again but it goes off the inner half and on the bounce to the keeper.
Brilliant fielding! Azam creams it through covers. It seems to be a certain boundary. Bairstow runs to his right and then dives and saves two for his side.
The googly on off, Azam strokes it to covers.
Nicely swept but good fielding keeps them down to one. On the leg side, Hafeez hits it towards deep backward square leg. Wood runs to his left and dives and saves three for his side.
This is eased down to long on for a single.
On the pads, Azam flicks it down the leg side and gets a single. Azam slips in his run but no damage done.
Fifty for Babar Azam. He has looked very good out in the middle and will look to convert this into a big one. He gets to his 13th ODI fifty by driving it wide of sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Good length ball outside off, Hafeez runs it down to third man for a single.
WIDE! Bouncer bounces too high! It is over the head of Hafeez who ducks under it. Wide given by the umpire. 50-run stand comes up between the two batsmen.
Slower ball on off, Hafeez does well to defend it.
Oh, just misses the outside edge. Full outside off, Hafeez looks to drive but gets beaten.
Starts with a good length ball on off, Hafeez defends it and looks for a quick run but Babar turns him down.
Jofra Archer is back into the attack.
FOUR! 14 from the over! Azam moves onto 49. Poor delivery to follow up three good ones. Short and on middle, Azam goes back and hammers the pull over mid-wicket.
Another dot as Azam once again keeps it out.
Well bowled! Slows it up and lands it on leg stump, Azam closes the face of the bat early. It goes off the leading edge back to the bowler. A soft leading edge though.
Sensible batting! Need not take a risk now so gently taps it to mid-wicket.

SIX! 10 from the first two balls! The last two balls have forced Morgan to push mid on back. Azam uses his feet again, does not get to the pitch this time but still goes ahead with the shot. Manages to drag it over the long on fence.
FOUR! Up and over! Picks his spot well there. Sees the mid on is in the ring, uses his feet, Azam gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it over mid on for a boundary.
Edgy run! Length and outside off, Babar goes hard at it but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for one.
Good running again! Hafeez drops it towards mid on and gets it to the other end.
A single now towards mid-wicket. The fielder was right at the edge of the circle. A well-judged run.

Well fielded and then Roy throws it hard at the fielder next to him. Still frustrated about the dropped catch. Length and around off, Azam guides it towards point where Roy dives to his left and stops it. The umpire is not happy with how the ball was thrown so he has a word with the English skipper.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Nicely worked. On the pads, it is worked away from the fielder at deep square leg and two taken.
The bowler pulls out right at the end. We think he missed his run-up.
Outside off, Azam cuts it away towards point and keeps the strike with a single.
Short on off, Hafeez pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for one more.
On the pads, Babar flicks it away for a run.
Floated on off, Hafeez drives it towards cover and takes one.
WIDE! It is down the leg side, Buttler cannot hold onto it and the ball deflects away allowing them to take one.
Floated on off, Azam blocks it off the front foot.

DROPPED! Out of all the people, Roy has dropped a sitter. Rashid bowls a beautifully tossed up ball on middle and leg. Hafeez decides to take the charge and comes down the track. He looks to smack it over long off but gets no timing on it. The ball goes way high in the air. Roy comes running in from long off and he covers good ground. He keeps his eyes on the ball but it pops out of his hands at the last moment. A fairly simple catch for someone like Roy and a rare mistake from England in the field. They have been excellent till now and would hope this was just a one-off for them.
Length ball on off, Babar defends it to see off the over. Tidy over from Stokes. A run and a leg bye off this one.
Good length ball on the pads, Hafeez looks to flick but it goes off his thigh pad and they take a leg bye.
Close again! A very full ball outside off, Hafeez looks to play at it but misses. There was a noise there but it was off the bat hitting the ground.
Full outside off, Azam drives it to sweeper cover and gets one.
Full on off, Azam drives it but to the man at mid on.
Good ball! Length ball outside off, Babar looks to cut but misses.
A dot to end a tight first over by Rashid. Hafeez is early into the flick, trying to work it through square leg but it goes off the leading edge on the bounce to mid-wicket.
Azam now picks a single as he strokes it through covers.
Hafeez dances down the track but Rashid bangs it short. MH works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Hit hard but can't find the gap! Shorter and on off, Azam goes back and pushes it firmly but to covers.
Slightly shorter to begin with, Hafeez goes back and gently guides it through point for one.
Adil Rashid is into the attack now. Two right-handers at the crease so Eoin Morgan has decided to bring on the leggie.
This is played with an angled bat down to third man for a single. 9 from the over, a good one for Pakistan.

FOUR! Hafeez has started well here! His second boundary in 5 balls. Short and on the body, Hafeez manages to pull it in the gap in the backward square leg region. The fielder there does put in a dive but fails to stop it.
Slapped! Shortish and outside off, Azam hits it hard through point but close to the fielder in the deep. A single.
Well played again! This is short and outside off, Hafeez hangs back, plays it late and down to third man for one.
A short one but it comes at a good height for the batsman. Azam pulls it through square leg for another run.
Nicely driven! Full and on off, it is stroked through covers for a run.
Now follows it up with a single down to point. Hafeez will keep the strike. End of an eventful over from Moeen. 8 runs off the over but more importantly a wicket.
FOUR! Jeez! What a start this is from Hafeez. Tossed up on off, Hafeez shows aggression straightaway as he comes down the track and smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
Flighted on off, Azam strokes it wide of cover and gives the strike to Hafeez for the first time.
Shorter on off, Azam runs it down the third man region and gets a couple.
Floated on off, Azam defends it off the front foot.
Mohammad Hafeez is the new man in.

OUT! What a catch! Woakes has taken a stunner here. England's fielding has been their real strength till now in this tournament. Stokes in the first game and Woakes today. Moeen tosses it up on off, Imam comes down the track and lofts it wide of long off. It looks like it will go for a boundary on the bounce but Chris Woakes had other ideas. He runs to his right and dives full stretch to take an absolute beauty. No running away from Nelson as it has indeed struck here. Imam misses out on a well-deserved fifty. England needed something special to get rid of Imam and Woakes has pulled out something magical.
Almost played on! Good length ball on off, Babar looks to defend but he plays it late. Nelson almost struck there!
Bouncer! It is on the body, Imam pulls it away to deep mid-wicket and gets one.
Length ball outside off, Imam plays it to the man at point. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but to no avail.
Plays it late this time and guides it down to third man for a single.
Azam misses out there! This is short and outside off, Azam looks to upper cut but misses. Had he got bat on that, it could have gone all the way.
A leg bye! Very straight. The batter looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Stokes starts appealing but then bails out. The ball rolls towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully played. Tossed up on off, Babar plays one of the toughest shots, the inside out one. He executes it perfectly over wide mid off which goes on a bounce to the fence.
Floated on off, Imam stands tall and punches it towards cover for one.
On middle and leg, Babar flicks it to mid-wicket and gets one.
On off, Imam taps it wide of point for one.
Good fielding. Shorter on off, Azam strokes it wide of the wide mid on fielder there. Stokes runs and dives to his left to keep it down to one.
Shorter on off, BA strokes it to the man at wide on.
5 runs off Stokes' first. Good length ball on off, Azam nudges it down to third man and gets a single to keep the strike. The 100 comes up for Pakistan!
Good length ball on off, Imam taps it down to third man for one.
Full on off, Babar drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length ball on off, Imam runs it down wide of backward point and takes a single.
Strays it on the pads this time, Azam flicks it to deep square leg and gets one.
Starts with a good length ball outside off, Babar has a poke at it and misses.
Ben Stokes is into the attack now. He was the Man of the Match in the tournament opener.
Floated on off, Imam defends it to get through the over.
Floated on off, Azam drives it to sweeper cover and gets one.
Floated around off, Babar plays it wide of sweeper cover for a couple.
On the pads, Imam flicks it away to the on side for a single.
Floated on off, Imam looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge.
Shorter on off, Azam strokes it wide of cover for one.

Drinks Break! Pakistan have got off to a good start here but the wicket of Zaman would be something that will give England some confidence. The openers got off to a good start but the introduction of Moeen and Wood has not just stemmed the run flow but has also provided them with a wicket they were desperately looking for. They were 62/0 in the first 8 but in the last 8, they have scored just 28 runs.
Driven away to deep cover for a run by Babar. He keeps strike for the next over.
On a length outside off, defended towards cover on the front foot by the right-hander.
FOUR! Fourth short ball in a row and this time, the batsman takes toll of it. Bowled on middle and leg, the ball is pulled away with ease wide of fine leg. The ball reaches the fence.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.

Another pacy short ball outside off, Azam looks to pull this through mid-wicket but the ball comes on to the bat quicker than he expected it to and it goes in the air towards mid on. Luckily for Babar, the ball does not carry to the fielder!
Sharp bouncer! At 142 clicks and bowled on middle and leg, Babar ducks under it at the right moment to let the ball go through.
On the stumps, Imam blocks it to see off an excellent over from Moeen. Just three runs off it and more importantly the opening stand has been broken.
Short again on middle and off, Babar strokes it wide of diving mid off fielder and gets a run as the ball goes to long off.
Shorter on the body, Imam tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, Babar turns it away to backward square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Azam starts with a solid front foot defense to start his innings.
Babar Azam walks out at number 3!

OUT! The back foot is not just outside the crease but also is in the air. England finally break the opening stand! Moeen bowls a beautifully tossed up ball on off, Zaman looks to push it but  the ball spins away fantastically after pitching. Fakhar comes forward in his attempt to push. Buttler behind the stumps takes the bails off in a flash. He puts in a very confident appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and shows that Zaman had stretched out too much and Buttler was too quick for him to get back in time. The giant screen shows OUT and Zaman walks back. A well-deserved wicket for Moeen and Buttler who did not have a great game behind the stumps in the previous game has done magnificently well here. Seems like the practice he did yesterday has paid off!

Stumping appeal taken upstairs! A flatter and quicker off spinner outside off bowled by Moeen and Fakhar misses the ball coming ahead. Buttler collects and quickly whips the bails off! Was the back foot outside the crease?
Good length ball on off, Imam defends it to finish off the over.
WIDE! Good length ball but it is down the leg side, Imam looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
Bouncer on the body, Zaman pulls it in a controlled manner to deep mid-wicket for one.

Wrong end! A fuller ball outside off, driven straight to extra-cover by Zaman and he looks for a single but his partner turns his back on him. Morgan picks up the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but Imam was well in. The other end was where there was no batsman as Fakhar was halfway down the ground. The batsman do not run even as there is a chance to take the overthrow now. Playing it safe!
Edge but short. Length ball outside off, Fakhar looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which goes to Buttler behind on a bounce.
Good length ball on off, Imam taps it wide of point and gets a single.
Full on off, Imam plays a classic front foot defense to it.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Imam nudges it to long on and keeps the strike with one. Tidy over from Moeen.
Floated on the stumps, Imam blocks it.

Floated on off, Zaman milks it to the left of extra-cover with not much timing and gets a run. Zaman wanted two as there was an overthrow chance but he does not get it as his partner sends him back wisely.
Bit of turn on offer. It is full on off, Zaman looks to drive but it goes uppishly off the outer half of his bat towards point. Lands well short of the fielder though.
Flatter on middle and leg, Zaman strokes it to the man at mid off.
Shorter on off, Imam strokes it wide of diving Moeen to long on for one.
Full outside off, Zaman looks to drive it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. He looks for a quick run but Imam says no. Another good over from Wood. Just 5 off his first two.
Back of a length ball on off, Imam pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full outside off, Zaman milks it to sweeper cover and rotates the strike.
A well bowled bouncer this. It is near the eye lid, Zaman looks to pull but misses.
Fuller on off, Imam taps it down to third man and gets a single.
Good length ball juts outside off, Imam has a tentative push but misses.
Flights it on off and middle, Imam keeps the strike with a single which he gets by stroking this tossed up ball to long on.
Floated on off, Zaman rotates the strike by nudging it to long off.
Shorter on off, Imam stands tall and punches it to long on for a single.
Flighted on off, Zaman milks it to long off and gets one.
Fires it on the pads, Zaman looks to flick but it goes to the off side off his pad.
Floated on the pads, Fakhar looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
Powerplay 2 time! 4 fielders can now be kept outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the 40th over.
Dot to finish! Tight start, just 2 from Wood's first. Back of a length ball outside off, Imam looks to defend it but gets beaten.
Bouncer! It is outside off, Imam sits under it.
Pulls his length back and bowls it on the good length area outside off, Zaman looks to cut but it goes off the outer half of his bat towards third man for a single.
Full on off, Fakhar strokes it to the man at mid off.
Full outside off, Imam drives it to the left of cover fielder. The man there dives to his left but cannot stop the ball cleanly allowing them to take one.
Starts with a 140 kph ball full around off, Imam pushes it to the man at mid off.
Double change. Mark Wood is introduced into the attack from the other end.
A drifter on middle and off, it is kept out by Fakhar from the crease.
This time the flatter ball on middle is turned away to deep square leg for a single.
Pushed from the crease towards mid-wicket by the southpaw.
Worked off the pads towards square this time by Imam.
FOUR! Flatter again on the pads but this time the glance from Imam is really fine. It beats short fine leg and runs away to the fence with ease. Such a fine tickle!
Bowled flatter on the pads, Imam tucks it down to short fine leg but cannot find the single he wants.
Time for spin. Moeen Ali comes on to bowl now!
Good length ball on middle and leg, Fakhar drives it wide of mid on and gets a couple. Another expensive over. 13 off this one.
WIDE! Once again the short ball is too short. It goes over the head of Zaman and it has been wided.
On the pads, Fakhar flicks it wide of deep square leg once more and gets easy two.
WIDE! Bouncer bounces too high. It goes over the head of Imam. Buttler gets his glove to it but cannot take it cleanly allowing them to steal a run.
On the pads, Imam flicks it wide of deep square leg and gets two.

NOT OUT! There is a big inside edge there and England lose their sole review. Fuller ball pitching on middle and leg and it comes in at the end. Imam looks to defend but it looks like he has been beaten and the ball hits him on the pads. The English players put in a big appeal but the umpire is unmoved. They think about it and then Morgan takes the review. Replays roll in and show there was a big inside edge. Ultra Edge confirms the same too and Imam survives. Poor review by England.
Review time! Archer raps Imam right in front of the stumps and appeals loudly but it is turned down by the umpire. Eoin Morgan takes the review, if there is no edge there, it looks quite adjacent.
FOUR! Fifty comes up with that boundary. Pakistan are off to a flier. Good length ball on middle and leg, Imam flicks it between mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Imam looks to defend but gets an outside edge which goes on a bounce to second slip.
Play and miss. Good length ball outside off, Imam looks to play it on the off side but misses. Another good over for Pakistan. 12 off it.
Outside off on a length, Imam runs it down to third man and rotates the strike.
On the body, Imam flicks it towards backward square leg. They stroll through for the second as the fielder from deep sqquare leg comes and cleans it up.
Short ball on off, Fakhar this time pulls it to the right of deep square leg and gets a single.

FOUR! Fakhar looks in the modd. Jeez! Who can say they were bundled out for 105 in the last game. Length ball on middle, Zaman shuffles across to his off stump and paddles it over the fine leg region for a boundary.
FOUR! Nothing but a hit me delivery. Good length ball outside off, Fakhar's eyes lit up looking at it and the crisply hits it through covers for a boundary.
On middle and leg, Imam flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.

Pakistan are riding their luck here. Back of a length ball on off and middle, Zaman looks to defend but it lob off the top half of the outside edge which goes above and between of first and wide second slip and they take one as the fielder at third man mops it up.
Fakhar pushes at this length ball outside off but fails to put bat on ball.
Good length ball on off, Zaman drives it to the man at cover.
FOUR! This will give him confidence! Archer bangs it in short on the body, Fakhar stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

On a length on the pads, Imam looks to glance it fine and there is a short fine leg in place! Luckily, the ball goes on a bounce to the left of Stokes there. Ben gets a hand to the ball and hence allows only for a single to be taken.
Dot to finish an expensive over. 11 runs off the over. It is full outside off, Fakhar looks to hit it but misses.
Good length ball on the pads, Imam flicks it to the on side and gets a single.

FOUR! Edgy this but Imam will take it. Back of a length ball, it goes away after pitching. Imam looks to defend but it takes the outside edge of his bat and goes to the vacant third man region for a boundary. Second slip had no chance to get that.
SIX! First one of the day and it has come off Imam's bat. First sign of aggression this from Imam. Length ball on off, Imam comes down the track and and smashes it over long on fence for a maximum.
Good length ball on off, Imam confidently defends it.
Confident looking stroke that. Fuller on off, Imam drives it but straight to mid off.
Now he gets a single. Good length ball on the pads, Imam tucks it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Back of a length ball on off, Imam defends it off his back foot. 8th dot in a row for him.
Bouncer! It is on the body and these balls did the damage for Pakistan in the last game. Here though, Imam has ducked under it.
Seam up delivery which is full outside off, the ball goes on a bounce to Buttler behind the stumps. He fumbles which allows them to take a bye.

FOUR! Fakhar pulls this away with ease. Slightly back of a length on middle and the pitch is so good that every time a bowler misses his mark, he will be punished. Short of a length on middle, FZ pulls this away with ease through mid-wicket and all the way to the fence. Easy pickings and one has to say Fakhar is looking good here.
Good ball on the corridor of uncertainty again from Archer, Zaman lets the ball go this time.

Maiden from Woakes. Excellent stuff this. He bowls the last ball full on middle, Imam drives it straight back to the bowler. Woakes gets down in time to stop the ball and he also tumbles after saving it.
Five dots in a row now. Woakes pulls his length back and it is outside off, Imam goes for the cut but misses.
Oh! That was very close. Fuller ball outside off, tempting Imam to go for the drive. He does go for it but misses and the ball just whizzes the outside edge.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Imam tucks it to mid-wicket and looks for a quick single which was never there and Fakhar rightfully says no.
Now bowls it on the off stump line, Imam defends it to the man at point.
Good length ball outside off, Imam leaves it alone.

Play and a miss! Good length ball on the fifth stump line, Fakhar comes down the track and throws the kitchen sink at it but misses. He looks the at the umpire asking for wide but the umpire is happy with the delivery.
Another beauty! Good length ball on middle and off, this one nips back in after pitching, Zaman looks to defend but the ball dissects him in half as it goes to the keeper.
Good ball! Archer hits the deck hard on middle and off, it moves away with the angle, Zaman looks to defend but gets beaten.
Good length ball outside off, Zaman leaves it alone.
FOUR LEG BYES! Jofra bowls it on the pads, Fakhar looks to flick it but it goes off his thigh pad through fine leg region for four.
Starts with a length ball on middle and leg, Imam looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge and it goes down to third man for  a single.
Jofra Archer will bowl with the other new ball!
FOUR! Excellent start for Pakistan. Woakes is guilty of offering width to Fakhar. He slashes his cut through point and this time no one has a chance to stop that one. 9 runs off the first over.
Follows it up with a solid back foot defense.

FOUR! Fakhar is off the mark and that too with a boundary. Length ball outside off, Fakhar cuts it wide of point. Morgan moves to his right and looks to save it with a dive but it goes through him and it races away on this quick outfield. Roy chasing it cannot reach the ball and shows his frustration by kicking the boundary skirting.
Good length ball juts outside off, Fakhar knows where his off stump is and confidently shoulders arms to this one.
First run off the game. Length ball outside off, Imam runs it down to third man and gets a single.
Woakes starts with a length ball outside off. It goes with the angle away from Imam. He chooses not to get on the way of the ball and lets it go to the keeper.

Done and dusted with the national anthems and we are all set for the game to begin. England players are in a huddle and their skipper, Eoin Morgan is having a few words before the players take their respective positions in the field.Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq walk out to open the innings for Pakistan. The first new ball is in the hands of Chris Woakes, he will start the proceedings for England.

Both sets of players walk out to the middle for their respective national anthems. First up, it will be visitors, Pakistan's national anthem followed by England's. We are not far away from the start of the game.

Pakistan XI - Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Babar Azam, Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik (IN FOR HARIS SOHAIL), Sarfaraz Ahmed (WK/C), Asif Ali (IN FOR IMAD WASIM), Shadab Khan, Hasan Ali, Wahab Riaz, Mohammad Amir.
England XI - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan (C), Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler (WK), Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Jofra Archer, Adil Rashid, Mark Wood (IN FOR LIAM PLUNKETT).

Pakistan skipper, Sarfaraz Ahmed says he wanted to bowl first as well. On the wicket he says it looks like a very good wicket. On short ball being an issue after the previous game, Sarfaraz says it was just a one-off problem and it won't happen again. Hopes that they can do well against England as they have played them recently in the ODI series. On how he feels about the losing streak, Sarfaraz tells that they are not reading too much at it.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says the wicket looks very good and states the dimensions are small so they believe chasing down a score will be good. The skipper mentions that it is a different day, so they have to play again well from the beginning again. Informs that they have one change, Mark Wood comes in, in place of Liam Plunkett. Eoin tells that the reason is due to how Pakistan played the short stuff, also feels that Mark Wood bowled well with pace on this ground in the ODI series versus Pakistan. The England skipper admits that there is always room to improve and perform better on the given day and as long as the ambition to perform well is there, it is good for the team.
TOSS - England skipper, Eoin Morgan has the coin in hand. Up it goes, Sarfaraz calls Tails but it lands in favour of England. ENGLAND OPT TO BOWL FIRST.

PITCH REPORT - Kumar Sangakkara and birthday boy, Wasim Akram are the pitch analysts for the game. Sangakkara says it is a place where bowlers dread to bowl. He informs us that the longer boundaries are when one bats at the Pavilion end and the boundaries behind the square are short. Akram, from the other end, agrees with Sangakkara and reminds us that it is the same venue where England scored 480-plus against Australia. States that the pitch is harder and it is a batting paradise as the ball will come onto the bat nicely. The birthday boy reckons that the captain winning the toss should bat first.

Hello and welcome to match 6 of the ICC Cricket World Cup 2019. Hosts England take on a depleted Pakistan side who are on a 12-game winless run and are low on confidence after being thrashed by West Indies. Sarfaraz Ahmed and his men will need to put up a better show against the mighty English who will look to make it 5 out of 5 in the last 5 ODIs against them. Will unpredictable Pakistan spring another surprise or will England complete the job? Stay tuned to find out as the Pitch report and Toss is not far away.
